thread:
Maya: Quick sync — proposing a new 'bench entropy' metric to gate model onboarding and to decide pin durations. Goal: reduce customer regressions while keeping catalog size manageable. Thoughts?

Arjun: +1. How are we computing entropy in practice? cohort-level token variance or something else? Need a concrete formula to put in the spec.

Priya: Pilot results: we compute sample-level softmax entropy and average across a prompt set, normalized by token length. Simple implementation: ```entropy = -sum(p * log p) / n_tokens``` on the model logits. Correlates with hallucination/instability in our evals.

Sam: Ops note — pin duration is a real infra tradeoff. Longer pins -> more GPU pool fragmentation and harder bin-packing for Dedicated. We should surface default caps.

Leo: From CS: enterprise customers keep asking for a "stability pin" option (90 days) as part of contracts. They also want an explicit rollback window + comms if we auto-migrate.

Maya: Proposed guardrails (initial):
- Onboard gate: must meet perf benchmarks AND bench_entropy <= 2.0 (pilot baseline).
- Default pin: 14 days for free/self-serve customers.
- Enterprise opt-in pin: 90 days behind a contract flag.
- Drift detection: if drift_score increases by > 0.3 over a 30d rolling window, trigger canary + rollback policy.
- Canary plan: 5% traffic for 7 days before full swap.

Arjun: Implementation notes for product/engineering spec: add model metadata fields on catalog entries: `bench_entropy`, `drift_score`, `pin_tier` (enum: default, enterprise, locked). API backwards compatible: catalog POST/PUT accepts optional fields. Need migration plan for existing models (populate null -> run batch eval).

Priya: Eval harness changes: append entropy per-prompt to eval CSV + add CLI flag `--entropy-threshold`. We'll include per-cohort breakdowns so PMs can see variance. Suggest adding a small prompt suite for stability-sensitive customers.

Sam: Ops pieces: alerting and automation: when drift_score > threshold, trigger evaluation-run, create a rollback ticket, and if canary fails auto-fallback to previous pinned version. Also include cost guardrails so canaries don't blow committed capacity.

Maya: Outstanding questions: exact entropy threshold, how we surface this in Console, and migration UX for pinned customers. Action items: @Arjun draft API spec + migration plan, @Priya add eval output and thresholds, @Sam define ops runbook and alert thresholds, @Leo collect enterprise customer opt-in language for 90d pin. We'll present a consolidated spec to PMT on Friday. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Reminder — PMT meeting Friday 10:00am in #all-hands.

Arjun: I can have a first pass API PR by Thu afternoon.

Priya: I'll add entropy to the nightly eval job and attach a short report template.

Sam: I'll sketch the rollback playbook and infra cost limits today.

Maya: Thanks everyone — syncing in-thread worked well. I'll assemble the spec doc after your PRs and link it to the PMT agenda. :thumbsup:
